title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-10-25
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending
ranking_explanation: Included repositories were collected from GitHub's all-language daily Trending page and ranked by the displayed stars-today figure. The page's ebook-treasure-chest collection was excluded as a list-only repo.
global_caveat: Star-gain values and total stars are a point-in-time snapshot and can change during the day. Trending prominence is not a quality or security endorsement.
corroboration: GitHub Search API exact-name queries and unauthenticated GitHub REST repository/default-branch commit endpoints; current README files for project descriptions and design details.

themes.title: Security and controlled agent execution
themes.content: Cloudflare's security-audit-skill turns auditing into staged reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, independent candidate verification and structured reporting; NVIDIA OpenShell focuses on sandboxed execution, policy enforcement and credential isolation; AWS packages AWS-specific agent tools and guardrails.

themes.title: Agent workflows and harnesses
themes.content: Cindy unifies local files, apps, multiple harnesses, skills and scheduled work; claude-howto teaches agent features as practical workflows; Gemini CLI remains a familiar terminal agent, while AWS's toolkit supplies agents with cloud-specific tools.

themes.title: Design quality for AI-generated interfaces
themes.content: Hallmark and Impeccable both turn taste and quality into repeatable agent workflows: Hallmark uses a large theme catalog and tiered checks, while Impeccable combines reusable commands with deterministic frontend detectors.

themes.title: Embodied AI and reinforcement learning
themes.content: Microduck is a physical biped robot driven by learned policies, with an explicit simulation-to-real training path and on-device control software.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time (UTC): 2026-10-25 00:33 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-10-25 through 2026-10-25. Ranking basis: daily GitHub Trending star gains, sorted descending.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Agent-focused projects dominate the daily list, led by a security-audit workflow and NVIDIA's sandbox runtime. The other strong signal is operationalizing AI output: repeatable design checks, coding-agent learning material, and a local multi-harness agent are all gaining stars.

sections.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
sections.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
sections.why_notable: The largest displayed daily gain; its README describes a six-phase audit workflow that separates reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation and independent verification.

sections.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
sections.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
sections.why_notable: Second-highest daily gain; its README differentiates it with isolated sandboxes, runtime kernel policy checks, credential mediation and formal review of policy changes.

sections.title: pbakaus/impeccable
sections.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
sections.why_notable: A leading design-quality project by daily gain; it packages 24 design commands and 62 deterministic frontend detector rules, with optional live browser iteration.

sections.title: makecindy/cindy
sections.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent.
sections.why_notable: Its daily gain puts a relatively small but rising project near the top; the README describes a local desktop/mobile client that can switch between Claude Code and Codex while keeping workspace context continuous.

sections.title: Nutlope/hallmark
sections.description: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
sections.why_notable: One of two design-focused entries in the top five; Hallmark uses a 48-theme catalog, browser-based checks and separate hard-floor, overridable-reflex and non-blocking-finish gates.

sections.title: luongnv89/claude-howto
sections.description: A visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code — from basic concepts to advanced agents, with copy-paste templates that bring immediate value.
sections.why_notable: A practical guide rather than another agent runtime; its learning path combines visual tutorials and reusable examples for skills, hooks, subagents and MCP.

sections.title: pollen-robotics/microduck
sections.why_notable: A counterpoint to the software-agent cluster: this is robot control software for a small biped, using a 50 Hz loop and reinforcement-learning policies trained in a separate MuJoCo/PPO project.

sections.title: google-gemini/gemini-cli
sections.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
sections.why_notable: An established terminal-agent project still present in the daily view, useful as a mature counterpoint to newer tools despite a modest gain in this snapshot.
sections.unique_caveat: Its current README says Gemini CLI was replaced by Antigravity CLI for unpaid-tier and Google One users on 2026-06-18, and is not optimized for the newest Gemini models.

sections.title: aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws
sections.description: Official, AWS-supported MCP servers, skills, and plugins to help AI agents build on AWS
sections.why_notable: Its small gain still signals a corporate-backed toolchain for agents: the README covers AWS CLI integration, coding-agent plugins and service-specific knowledge and guardrails.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent security and control: Cloudflare security-audit-skill and NVIDIA OpenShell emphasize auditability and restricted execution, while AWS supplies agent-specific cloud tools. Agent workflow tooling: Cindy, claude-howto and Gemini CLI represent different layers—local orchestration, learning materials and a terminal interface. Frontend design quality: Hallmark and Impeccable turn design guidance into checks and reusable agent commands. Robotics: Microduck is a physical-world exception, combining on-device control with learned policies. Languages among the nine entries: Rust (3), TypeScript (2), Python (2), JavaScript (1), and CSS (1).

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest daily momentum is around making AI agents safer and more dependable, not just more capable: explicit audit stages, sandbox policy, design checks and reusable workflows all feature prominently. The list is not exclusively software agents—Microduck stands out as an embodied-learning project—and the mature Gemini CLI entry shows that an established tool can still trend even when its README points users toward a successor.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary: GitHub all-language daily Trending view, https://github.com/trending?since=daily. Corroboration: GitHub Search API exact-name queries and public REST repository and default-branch commit endpoints. Project details: current first-party README files; NVIDIA and AWS documentation linked from those README files. Daily gains are copied from the matching Trending view and ranked descending; totals, languages and commit SHAs come from GitHub API data. No prior-window comparison is claimed.
